settings.heading: Made for every woman who calls the island home
settings.text: Korean skincare, picked by hand and delivered all over Mauritius.

settings.image_alt: Two women laughing together on a beach in Mauritius
settings.heading: How it started
settings.text:
It started with a simple frustration. The Korean skincare everyone was talking about online was either impossible to find in Mauritius, or sold by people who couldn't say where it came from.

So we set up in Mon Gout and did it properly. Real products, honest prices, and delivery anywhere on the island.

We're small and we're new, and we like it that way. Every product is picked by hand, for skin that lives with sun, salt and humidity. Nothing to decode, nothing you don't need.

settings.title: Authentic
settings.text: The real product, with its full ingredient list on its page. If we're not sure about something, we don't sell it.

settings.title: Affordable
settings.text: In Korea, great skincare isn't priced like luxury. It shouldn't be here either.

settings.title: For all of us
settings.text: Every skin tone, every budget, every corner of the island. You already belong here.
